_note: Proliferator effects. `speed` multiplies craft speed, `productivity` multiplies output quantity, `power` multiplies the machine's draw. A recipe may narrow this list with `modifiers_supported`; absent means all of them are allowed, and a modifier with no effect (speed 1, productivity 1) is always allowed regardless, so "none" never needs listing. `fallback` is the modifier to use when this one is not permitted — the extra-products modes fall back to the speed mode of the same tier, so the proliferator is still applied.
